title: Dim interiors
summary: Lava chambers and turf houses: EV 4–6 light where the meter begs and flash ruins everything.
why: Indoors at EV 5, a handholdable shutter needs every stop the kit has: the 35mm wide open at f/1.8 plus ISO 1600–3200. That's the tool for this job — the 55-200 at f/4-5.6 simply can't buy enough light.

steps.text: Mount the 35mm — this is its whole reason for being in the bag
Mode dial to A, front dial wide open
Hold ISO, rear dial to 1600; go to 3200 before you accept blur
Brace on a wall or rail; exhale, squeeze

pitfalls: f/1.8 depth of field is millimeters up close — put the focus point exactly where it matters.
Noise at 3200 cleans up in post; camera shake never does. Grain over blur, always.
levelUp: A doorway or single lamp is a light source with direction — expose for the lit side and let the rest fall to black. Caves are chiaroscuro.
